scenes.script:
Priya says: Ah!
Unknown Voice says: Kya hua?
Priya says: My hands on fire!
Miss Nova says: Actually, isse "My hands are burning" bolte hain.
Priya says: Kehna easy hai! Jab bhi English bolna padta hai, main freeze ho jaati hoon.
Miss Nova says: Main hoon Miss Nova. Main Supernova AI par aapko English sikhati hoon, aapse actually speak karwa kar.

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Main aapka exact level analyze karti hoon aur aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon.
Priya says: Par agar mujhse mistakes ho gayi toh? Mujhe bohot shy feel hota hai.
Miss Nova says: 1000 mistakes kijiye! Yahan koi aapko judge nahi kar raha hai. Main aapko correct karti hoon aur aapki apni language Hindi mein logic explain karti hoon.
Miss Nova says: Din mein bas 15 minutes real-life scenarios practice kijiye, aur 1 month mein aapko visible progress dikhne lagegi.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Personalized plan just for you
1000 mistakes kijiye
Koi aapko judge nahi karega

scenes.script:
Priya says: Yeh toh badhiya hai, par abhi main expensive classes afford nahi kar sakti.
Miss Nova says: Supernova AI regular coaching classes se saat guna sasta hai.
Priya says: Really? Saat guna sasta?
Miss Nova says: Reels scroll karne mein hours waste karna band kijiye. Iske badle mere sath 15 minutes speak kijiye.
Priya says: Main abhi Supernova AI download kar rahi hoon, speaking start karne ke liye!

Kept the quoted English lines exactly verbatim as required by T2a. Replaced 'your own language' with 'Hindi' per T5. Ensured polite 'aap-tier' register for Miss Nova and natural spoken WhatsApp-style romanization throughout.

violations.fix: Replace the Google Play Store overlay with a standard, non-interactive 'Download Now' button graphic or end card.
